_what_this_is: A package bump on one line and no entry. The 10.11 line's floor moves from 10.11.11.0 to 10.12.0.0, both lines are still declared and the manifest version is untouched, so the drop rule and the version rule both stay silent and this is the only thing between the change and a server on 10.11.11 that is never offered another version and is told nothing about why. It has to be refused, and refused for this rule rather than for another, because a document some other rule already refuses proves nothing about this one.
title: Build the 10.11 line against 10.12.0 (#91)
body: The referenced package moves up a minor. For #91.
manifest_before:
---
name: "Watch Sync"
version: "0.4.0.0"
targetAbi: "10.11.11.0"
framework: "net9.0"
targets:
- framework: "net9.0"
  targetAbi: "10.11.11.0"
- framework: "net10.0"
  targetAbi: "12.0.0.0"
manifest_after:
---
name: "Watch Sync"
version: "0.4.0.0"
targetAbi: "10.12.0.0"
framework: "net9.0"
targets:
- framework: "net9.0"
  targetAbi: "10.12.0.0"
- framework: "net10.0"
  targetAbi: "12.0.0.0"
